tenures.source: Tagged WOLF in the RSPWF Top 200 Tag Teams for 1998.

caption: Ranked #59 in the RSPWF Top 200 Tag Teams for 1998 (Falcon & Eagle), tagged WOLF.

identity.note: The registry's own decorated-aka guard reads this name as a normalized substring match against birds-of-prey-wwa. Recorded distinct, not merged: the only record this entity has is a placing in the RSPWF Top 200 Tag Teams, which gives a team name, a federation tag, and (where named) its two members' ring names, and nothing else -- no dates, no roster, no URL, so three of the collision doctrine's own four signals are simply absent and the no-merge default holds. Every held-promotion roster the ranked names were checked against came back with zero overlap. Reopenable the moment either side gains a record the other can be checked against.
